sources.title: GitHub - machinefi/trio-spark: Trio-Spark v1.0 — fast judgment for the ...
sources.snippet: Trio-Spark is a Situated World Model built for fast judgment. Give it the state of an environment and 2-8 possible moves. In one pass, it returns the best next move and a probability for every choice.

sources.title: Trio: The World Model for Physical Operations | MachineFi Labs
sources.snippet: The World Model For Physical Operations Trio is a multi-modal AI that fuses video, audio, and sensor streams into operational intelligence — purpose-built for the physical environments language models can't see.

sources.title: Technical Paper — Trio | MachineFi Labs
sources.snippet: Inside the Trio technical paper. The foundation system for physical-world understanding — how Trio reaches frontier-model accuracy at a fraction of the cost and latency, written for the people who build on it.

sources.title: Trio — the world model for physical operations
sources.snippet: Trio sees, understands, and foresees what your cameras see — frontier accuracy, fast enough to watch every frame. See (Trio-Retina) → Understand (Trio-Lumen) → Foresee (Trio-Spark).
